name: 連絡先の配信同意・ワークフロー一括操作メニュー
prompt:
Recreate only the HubSpot bulk-action menu in the primary original crop. Match the 420x347 composition, white popover, thin gray border, subtle shadow, rounded corners and small upward pointer near x=30 at the top. Keep the source’s precise item indentation. No Japanese mock exists.

There are six rows in this exact order. The source has an icon only in rows 1, 2 and 5. For those three rows, place the icon in a narrow left column centered around x=35 and begin the label around x=55. For rows 3, 4 and 6, there is no icon, so begin the label around x=28; do not indent those rows into the icon column.

Row 1: exactly one dark four-point sparkle icon (no second star or decorative sparkle) and 「データ補完の充足状況を確認」. Row 2: dark list icon and 「静的リストに追加」. Row 3: no icon, 「ワークフローに登録」. Row 4: no icon, pale disabled text 「コンタクトデータ処理の法的根拠を追加」. Row 5: dark plus icon and 「コミュニケーション配信設定を編集」. Row 6: no icon, pale disabled text 「ダブルオプトインの状態を更新」.

Keep the source’s roomy, evenly spaced rows, dark-gray enabled labels, visibly low-contrast gray-blue disabled labels, same menu padding and white background. Do not add a heading, extra icons, separators, checkmarks, controls or actions. Do not shift the icon-free rows right.
reviewNotes: LH09-0262 v002 compared side by side with the original menu crop. It removes the extra sparkle and improves icon-free row indentation while keeping labels and disabled states. Remaining defects: the popover is inset by roughly 25 px from the crop edges and reduced in size; icon-row text still begins about 25 px too far right. Status: needs-correction after two attempts; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
